title: Fontina
id: MAR-0052
lang: en

servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 8 eggs
- 80 g speck
- 80 g fontina cheese
- 2 tablespoons parsley
- 40 g butter
- to taste Salt and pepper
## Method
1. Crack the eggs into a bowl, add the parsley, season with salt and pepper, and beat with a fork.
2. Grease a small nonstick pan with a little butter and pour in a quarter of the mixture.
3. Cook the omelette on both sides, place it on a plate, and cook the remaining ones the same way.
4. Top each omelette with speck and fontina cheese sliced thinly, then roll them up.
5. Grease a baking dish with the remaining butter, arrange the rolled omelettes in it, and place under the oven grill for a few minutes.
